title: Earth or Another World?
dek: Six close views test what terrain, atmosphere and scale can—and cannot—tell you.
learningObjective: Compare planetary images using visible evidence before relying on color, familiarity or captions.

steps.prompt: Without the caption, what tells you how large this landscape is?
Which boundaries look carved, deposited or eroded?
Where does the solid world end and its atmosphere begin?
Could these repeated forms belong to Earth? What evidence is missing?
What makes this glow different from light on the surface?
Which familiar pattern appears around a planet unlike Earth?
